delivery: Unreleased incremental source work; no version bump, commit, push, installer or installation.
scope: Portable strict standalone scene behavior manifests use stable scene, instance, binding and registered TXT source UUIDs, bounded scalar parameters and declared signal-event aliases.

Only the saved scene metadata behavior relation opts into execution; frozen plan/runtime 3 carries sources and provenance. Static saved/draft/recipe previews retain geometry-only plan2, and ordinary saves/full backups preserve unfinished source.

Linux Godot 4 adapter loads independent Node instances, validates own exported scalar properties and typed 0–4 argument signals, then routes per-binding events. Generator/runtime extension is separate from original v1/v2 byte-frozen implementation.

Frozen host compilation and runtime diagnostics navigate to registered TXT source lines or exact manifest parameter pointers. The UI shows counts and identity-bearing events in Chinese, English and Japanese without parsing scripts.

Selective resource packages recompute body dependencies, validate registered edges and bound actor definitions, preserve exact source bytes, recheck pinned scene/script dependencies and fence permitted transitive actor reads.

Malformed actor collections and coercible diagnostic code/parameter arrays are rejected as structured diagnostics; new sample media and registration files remain visible to Git via narrowly scoped ignore exceptions.

hostWorkflow.scope: Initial full real Godot workflow run. The same 10 cases reran in the final full app after malformed-input hardening.

nativeBuilds.scope: This increment changed no Rust source or WASM. Current native core/archive/mobile helpers were compiled offline and supplied to the final app regression; earlier standalone Rust checks retain their historical scope.

harnessAndVerificationNotes: The initial native helper build required the prepared embedded Node sidecar and failed before resource preparation; after desktop preparation the offline final helper build succeeded. Both logs are retained.

The first portable workflow fixture assumed one relation spelling and lacked the required draft sourcePath. Valid nonownership metadata edges and the actual draft DTO are now used; the first log and successful final portable/real runs are retained.
Initial browser acceptance passed but captured the top viewport. The final smoke run scrolls the relevant events and diagnostic sections into view; both screenshot sets remain separate.

The initial full app passed 1648/1648 before final malformed-input review. Additional cases inside existing tests now reject actors:{find:1}, null and [null], plus JSON arrays in diagnostic code/parameter fields. Final full app and final prepared checks use the hardened source.

Prepared artifacts from before the final review are explicitly archived as initial. Final preparation was rerun after both parser and runtime-reader hardening; all reported final source/package hashes were stable during real execution.

The source-hash inventory excludes editable current documentation/README but includes sample author Markdown/templates, the new 231-byte sample image, asset metadata and scoped .gitignore rules; all 78 files were rechecked after full app and cleanup.
limits: Only Linux Godot 4/GDScript is a product executable backend. No Bevy, Nuislang, ns-nova, yalivia or C# integration is implemented.

The binding manifest is portable data and the extension uses independent Node behavior instances, own exported scalar properties and typed signals; it is not cross-engine source translation, RPC, arbitrary Variant reflection, hot reload, an authoring form or a general state machine.
Author scripts execute with the current user permissions. Generated directories and process isolation do not provide a code sandbox.
World v1 behaviorBindings stays empty; Scene2D author v2/v3 can opt in through one registered behavior relation. Static saved/draft/recipe previews do not validate or execute behavior code.

GPU compute, offscreen rendering and embedded engine viewport remain unsupported. Mobile validation proves only portable prepared planning/capabilities, not Android engine execution or UI/device acceptance.
This increment does not open, install or accept a new Tauri window and does not repeat the earlier graphical Godot preview; historical evidence remains at its original scope.
